structures.name: Steam Grinder Multiblock
structures.description: Build requirements for the formed Steam Grinder structure. This is supplemental planner metadata because the exporter only exposes the controller block recipes.
structures.source: GregTech Modern GTMultiMachines Steam Grinder multiblock pattern
notes: 3x3x3 shell with the controller in the front center and air in the middle.
Uses Steam Grinder macerating and ore-grinding recipes.
Steam hatch is required for steam input.
